include_intents: vector relations and identities in spatial figures
sum/difference/scalar multiplication of vectors in space
dot product and vector angle as vector concepts
parameter conditions whose main object is vector coordinates
exclude_primary_intents: plane equation or plane normal as the main task
line equation or line direction representation as the main task
sphere equation/center/radius/tangent plane as the main task
coordinate geometry distance tasks whose primary object is plane/line/sphere

mixed_group_policy.rule: Never split a shared-context TRUE_FALSE_FOUR during structural staging.
mixed_group_policy.action: Keep full group, set mixed_scope=true, classify each child during academic review.

visual_policy.source_validation: Do not redraw or fabricate; crop exact source later.

dedupe_policy.individual: normalized content hash + structure + answer signature where available
dedupe_policy.group: normalized shared context + ordered a/b/c/d child content hash
dedupe_policy.duplicate_action: Preserve one canonical candidate and all duplicate provenance references.
